name: feature.territories.nodes
description: Sales Territory Management node pack — seven READ nodes over the ctx.features.territories surface: list territory models (+ the active model), list a model's territories (hierarchy), list its assignment rules and quotas, dry-run a model's assignment preview, and compute per-territory attainment (weighted pipeline vs quota, rolled up the hierarchy, with per-rep splits). PLUS two GOVERNED WRITE nodes (A5 — v1.1.0): activate-model and set-quota, which enforce the run OWNER's scope (host:territories:manage / workspace:write; system runs denied) and are kept OUT of the advisory agent's allowlist. NOTE (CFP-1 / D9): the app drives the governed model activation/archival through the SHARED reviews approval gate (kind: territory-model-transition), not a direct agent tool call — no built-in workflow ignites these nodes; they stay composable catalog entries for a builder-authored chain. All nodes are role:"action", tenant+org-guarded (CTI-1); tenantId comes from the run scope, never node args.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Territories: List Models
nodes.description: Lists an org's territory models + the active model id over ctx.features.territories.listModels. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { models, activeModelId }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Territories: Active Model
nodes.description: Returns the org's currently-active territory model id (or null) over ctx.features.territories.activeModel. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { activeModelId }.

nodes.label: Territories: List Territories
nodes.description: Lists a model's territories (the parent-child hierarchy) over ctx.features.territories.listTerritories. Inputs: { orgId, modelId }. Output: { territories }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Territories: List Rules
nodes.description: Lists a model's assignment rules (priority-ordered) over ctx.features.territories.listRules. Inputs: { orgId, modelId }. Output: { rules }.

nodes.label: Territories: List Quotas
nodes.description: Lists a model's per-territory quotas over ctx.features.territories.listQuotas. Inputs: { orgId, modelId, period? }. Output: { quotas }.

nodes.label: Territories: Preview Assignment
nodes.description: Dry-runs a model's assignment rules against the org's live CRM records (no writes) over ctx.features.territories.previewModel — the per-territory coverage a re-org WOULD produce. Inputs: { orgId, modelId }. Output: { summary }.

nodes.label: Territories: Attainment
nodes.description: Computes per-territory attainment over ctx.features.territories.attainment: weighted pipeline (Σ amount × stage.probability) + won vs quota, rolled up the hierarchy, with per-rep splits keyed on deal owner. Inputs: { orgId, modelId, period? }. Output: { period, territories, unassigned }.

nodes.label: Territories: Activate Model
nodes.description: GOVERNED WRITE (ADR 0272 A5) — activates a territory model over ctx.features.territories.activateModel, changing CRM record visibility + forecasting org-wide. Enforces host:territories:manage against the RUN OWNER (system runs denied). Not in the advisory agent's allowlist. NOTE (CFP-1 / D9): no built-in workflow ignites this node — the app's actual governed activation rides the SHARED reviews approval gate (kind: territory-model-transition); this node stays a composable catalog entry. Inputs: { orgId, modelId }. Output: { success, model }.

nodes.label: Territories: Set Quota
nodes.description: GOVERNED WRITE (ADR 0272 A5) — sets a territory's per-period quota over ctx.features.territories.setQuota. Enforces workspace:write against the run owner (system runs denied). Inputs: { orgId, modelId, territoryId, period, amount, currency, repSplits? }. `currency` is REQUIRED whenever `amount` > 0 (R2 TER2-B3 — an amount with no unit cannot be compared with the deals it is measured by, and the host returns 400); a zero amount needs none. `repSplits` REPLACES the stored splits, so omit it only when you intend to clear them. Output: { success, quota }.
